visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless t-shirt and white shorts, stands in a grassy field during the golden hour of sunset. He waves his right hand enthusiastically toward the camera while holding a black smartphone in his left hand. Behind him, lush green trees and a dark wooden fence are visible under the warm, orange-tinted sunlight. (2) The scene transitions to a high-altitude drone shot overlooking a coastal settlement on an island. Red and yellow-roofed houses are clustered together near a lush green forest. In the foreground, a rocky cliff drops off into a deep blue sea where small groups of people are walking along the jagged edges under a hazy sunset sky. (3) A close-up displays a vibrant mural or painting of a sea turtle with large, expressive eyes on a bright yellow and orange background. The turtle has a textured, patterned shell and appears to be in a swimming pose. (4) The young man returns, seen dancing and spinning joyfully on a rocky outcrop against the backdrop of a vast, calm blue ocean under a clear sky. He wears the same white outfit and holds his phone. (5) An aerial view of a narrow sandy beach strip bordered by turquoise water on one side and a rocky, tree-covered hill on the other. People are scattered across the sand, and the man is seen walking and waving from the beach. (6) The camera shifts to a low-angle POV shot from a kayak or paddleboard. The man is sitting, wearing a black life vest over his white shirt, and using a paddle to navigate across the clear blue water. (7) He sits on a weathered log by the famous 'Flower Vase Rock' in Xiaoliuqiu, extending his arms wide in a gesture of freedom. The background shows the iconic rock formation standing in the shallow sea. (8) On a street lined with tropical plants, the man interviews two young women. One woman wears a black tank top and shorts, gesturing with her hands while speaking. The next shot shows another woman in a white tank top smiling brightly at night under warm artificial lighting. (9) The man is seen riding a scooter, wearing a grey helmet and a white Nike jacket, smiling at the camera as he navigates a paved road with greenery and the ocean in the distance. (10) A wide drone shot follows the scooter along a coastal road as the sun sets over the horizon, casting a long, shimmering reflection on the water. (11) The man is shown walking along a rugged, rocky coastline filled with driftwood and debris, looking out toward the sea under a soft evening light. (12) The video concludes with a high-angle drone shot of a group of approximately ten people standing on a high rocky cliff, waving their arms in unison toward the sky as the camera pulls back to reveal the expansive island landscape.
